segments.action: I ride my bicycle across the zebra crosswalk at an illuminated city intersection, following two cyclists on blue shared bikes and a pedestrian walking on my right.
segments.action_brief: I ride my bicycle across the crosswalk.
segments.environment: Physical space: Wide multi-lane asphalt city street intersection at night, illuminated by bright tall streetlights and vehicle headlights. A painted white zebra pedestrian crossing spans across the roadway. In the background across the street stands a multi-story hotel building with glowing neon rooftop signage XXX '汉庭酒店' and illuminated storefronts on the ground level including '交通银行'. A green pedestrian traffic signal is illuminated on the traffic pole. Objects: Front wire basket of my bicycle XXX in the bottom foreground; two cyclists ahead riding blue shared bicycles (XXX directly ahead in a white t-shirt, XXX to the left in a dark shirt and neon yellow shoes); a pedestrian woman on the right in a dark dress walking forward; metal median railings and waiting motor vehicles on the road in the distance. Screen content: None. World text: '汉庭酒店' glowing in blue neon atop the background building; '交通银行' on the left commercial storefront. Media playing: None. Ambient audio: Urban nighttime traffic hum, passing motor vehicle engines, and quiet street ambience.
segments.details: I maintain a steady speed on my bicycle, keeping behind the cyclist in the white t-shirt while tracking the crosswalk path.

segments.action: I continue pedaling across the middle of the zebra crosswalk as the cyclist ahead moves further forward toward the far curb.
segments.action_brief: I pedal across the crosswalk.
segments.environment: The pedestrian walking on the right moves ahead toward the edge of view; the cyclists in front continue advancing steadily across the crosswalk; headlights of oncoming waiting vehicles illuminate the wet asphalt surface.
segments.details: Both hands steer the bicycle handlebar while maintaining distance from the cyclists ahead.

segments.action: I ride forward across the remaining section of the crosswalk toward the opposite side of the intersection under the green signal.
segments.action_brief: I ride toward the far side of the road.
segments.environment: The cyclist in the white t-shirt approaches the far pedestrian curb; cars wait stationary at the intersection under the streetlights; the green pedestrian light remains lit.
segments.details: I keep riding forward straight across the striped crosswalk markings toward the illuminated opposite sidewalk.
